# Replays the regular-session fill campaign (ORD-001 fill variants)
# observed on 2026-06-11 against live paper Gateway during US market hours,
# six lifecycles on one connection:
#   371 MKT BUY 100   PreSubmitted, single fill 100 @ 292.79, commission
#                     1.0003 (realized PnL -68.051912 closing prior shorts)
#   372 MKT SELL 100  Submitted, fills 40 @ 292.33 + 40 @ 292.30 +
#                     20 @ 292.30 (avg 292.312)
#   373 MTL BUY 100   PreSubmitted -> Submitted, fills 40 + 60 @ 292.44
#   374 MKT SELL 100  fills 40 @ 292.36 + 40 @ 292.33 + 20 @ 292.33
#                     (avg 292.342)

#   376 MKT SELL 100  fills 40 + 40 + 20 @ 292.20
# A one-shot executions query then returns 15 executions (including two
# from the same day's earlier mkt buy/sell captures, orders 368/369) in the
# Gateway's "US/Eastern" time form and re-emits 14 commission reports; the
# 15th commission (the final 20-share fill) arrives only after
# executions_end. Live streaming execution times use the UTC dash form
# ("20260611-13:30:30"); both forms parse, so executions and commissions
# must reach the handles, and the query's re-emitted executions
# dual-dispatch to the still-open order routes (live answered 41 query
# updates total). The final safety global cancel draws real code-161
# replies for all six filled orders; in replay they remain session notices
# and each Filled status owns its handle's clean close.
# Sanitized: account identifiers redacted to the DU9000001 redaction token,
# perm ids -> 900368-900376, order refs ->
# ibkrgo-sanitized-20260611T133024Z-001..-006, execution ids ->
# sanitized-fill-001..-015 (-014/-015 are the foreign orders 368/369
# surfaced only by the query). Trimmed: farm-status 2104/2107/2158, the
# driver's startup safety global cancel and its code-161 replies for the
# previous captures' orders, and the driver's delayed-quote anchor exchange
# (market-data-type toggles, the req 1/2 tick stream, and the code-10089
# entitlement notice).
